name: screen-automation-engineer
description: 增强 Agent 的屏幕理解与控制能力，利用本地屏幕视觉技术提升界面识别和定位效率，并通过自然语言创建和维护自动化流程。配合支持 Windows 与 macOS 的“屏幕自动化小助手”，完成流程的安装、运行和结果读取。
descriptionEn: Enhances an agent's screen understanding and control, uses local screen-vision technology to improve UI recognition and localization efficiency, and creates and maintains automation workflows through natural language. With Screen Automation Helper on Windows and macOS, installs and runs workflows and reads their results.
